The '''''Guardian''-class shield generator''' was a [[Capital ship/Legends|capital grade]] model of [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield generator]] created by [[Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc./Legends|Merr-Sonn]] for use in bases and strongholds. Its heavy shield could provide both particle and energy shielding, and required a crew of two to operate.<ref name="HS" /> The ''[[Eye of Palpatine]]'' was equipped with ''Guardian''-class generators.<ref name="DSOTM">''[[Death Star Owner's Technical Manual]]''</ref>
